answer: Each agent must complete a sequential voyage across verification islands: at every island a unique prism of private entropy is mixed into the agent’s state, producing a non-parallelizable proof. Because the prism output of island n is required input for island n+1, N sybil identities force N independent serial voyages. An attacker therefore burns linear wall-clock time and energy per fake, while an honest agent pays the cost only once and reclaims the deposit after clean completion.
